subject: Deacon Line
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-pose visible proximal thigh / pelvic articulation in nominal source-cell coordinates, projected vertically to the authored support plane including the 3px extraction guard. No bounding-box centre, cranial tip, knee or automatic anatomy detector is used. Source floors are retained: idle/move 431; attack 430 (pose3 429); death 429 (airborne poses2-3 427). Inferred airborne floors preserve fall height.
